redactions.reason: Side conversation, unrelated to the agenda. Nothing is behind this marker — it is here to show how a withheld stretch renders.

segments.t: All right, we are recording. Let us start with the import pipeline, because it came up twice this week.
The short version is that anything past roughly eight minutes falls over, and it is always the large files.
Have we confirmed it is actually a timeout and not the worker running out of memory?
Confirmed. The worker is fine. It is a gateway timeout, and it is the same number every time.
So we raise the timeout.
We have raised the timeout twice already. Once to five minutes, once to eight.
Then that is the answer, isn t it. A timeout is a number you keep raising.
A timeout is a number you keep raising. A cap is a decision you make once and can explain to somebody.
What would the cap be?
Five hundred and twelve megabytes covers everything we have actually seen except three files last quarter.
And those three?
Those three go through the documented bulk path. It exists, it works, nobody knows about it.
Then the error message is the real work here. It has to name the limit and point at that path.
Agreed. Silent truncation would be much worse than a rejection.
[ side conversation — 00:03:20–00:03:34 not published ]
Let us move on. The checkout test.
It has been retried three times a run for about a month now.
We have retried it three times a run for a month. That is not a flaky test any more, that is a test we turned off and kept paying for.
So quarantine it, ticket it, and put a name on it.
And it stops gating merges until it is fixed. Otherwise we are just training everyone to ignore red.
Last thing. Next week.
Everything has passed locally, which at this point tells us almost nothing.
Two machines, end to end, with a real build. That is the milestone.
I will post the build so there is something to run against.
And I will get acceptance lines onto the three tickets that do not have them, so they show up in the queue.
Anything without a Done equals line is invisible to the dashboard, which is the point of it.
Good. That is the hour.
